title: Add P/B ratio as fundamental feature
rationale: Price-to-book ratio is a core value signal for 1-year horizons. Institutions accumulating low P/B stocks tend to outperform over 365d. Source: yfinance ticker.info['priceToBook'].

title: Add FCF yield as fundamental feature
rationale: Free cash flow yield (FCF / market cap) captures quality at a price. Strong predictor of institutional accumulation payoff over 365d. Source: yfinance financials + market cap.

title: Add revenue growth rate (YoY) as fundamental feature
rationale: Revenue growth rate (YoY) captures business momentum that institutions track for multi-year conviction positions. Source: yfinance quarterly financials.

title: Add ROIC as fundamental feature
rationale: Return on invested capital (ROIC) identifies durable competitive advantage. Stocks with ROIC > WACC compound over 365d. Source: yfinance financials + balance sheet.

title: Add net debt / EBITDA as fundamental feature
rationale: Leverage ratio filters out financially stressed positions. Low net debt/EBITDA tickers accumulate safely by institutions for 1-year holds. Source: yfinance balance sheet + earnings.

title: Remove short-term RSI features from long-term model
rationale: RSI (14d, 20d) is noise at the 365-day horizon. Including it may cause overfitting to short-term momentum patterns that have no predictive value over 1 year.

title: Train only on post-2018 data
rationale: Pre-2018 market structure (low rates, pre-passive-investing dominance) may introduce distributional shift. Restricting training to 2018+ aligns with current institutional behavior.

title: Weight value stocks 2x in training
rationale: Long-term institutional mandates (First Eagle, Dodge & Cox style) are concentrated in value stocks. Overweighting value tickers aligns the loss function with how long-horizon managers actually operate.

title: Retrain long-term model (17652 new labeled rows)
rationale: 17652 new outcome_252d rows were labeled since last check (total: 17652). Retraining will incorporate fresh ground truth.
